description: S458 2a-fix F2: writes into refined LOCAL bindings (no runtime setter) are judged by the obligations desugared into the AST — an element write `a[0] = v`, `a.push(v)` on a `number(>0)[]`, `k--` from 1, `Object.assign(l, { n: v })` into a refined struct, an annotated destructure `let { n }: L = …`, and a write from an expression-bodied arrow. Each throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT before the write, so no function reaches its `@done` append. In slice 2a all six were admitted.
rationale: §53.3.1: the predicate "is evaluated as a pure boolean expression over the incoming value at every assignment or binding site". §53.3.3: the check throws before the assignment is applied.
